requirements.title: Defined input/output procedure interfaces contain subroutines with 12.6.4.8.2 interfaces
requirements.definition: Every procedure specified in an interface block for a defined input/output procedure is a subroutine and has an interface described by 12.6.4.8.2.

pending.defined-io-procedures-are-subroutines: PENDING source-control plan: INTERFACE WRITE(FORMATTED) names subroutine write_formatted_box with the 12.6.4.8.2 dummy sequence; formatted WRITE of a TYPE(box) value with component 42 later observes exact characters under 12.6.4.8 execution ownership.
pending.defined-io-procedures-have-126482-interf: PENDING source-control plan: the conforming defined-I/O subroutine uses dtv, unit, iotype, v_list, iostat, and iomsg dummies with characteristics taken from 12.6.4.8.2; a mutation changes only one characteristic and claims no diagnostic here.
pending.defined-io-positive-source-control: PENDING dependency plan records this section as the interface-block owner and records all actual data-transfer effects, IOSTAT values, and IOMSG non-comparisons under 12.6.4.8.

requirements.oracle: This entry is a source registration for the interface requirement. Executable formatted or unformatted transfer effects remain with 12.6.4.8.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source registration only: no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim is created. Future fixtures must establish a non-default positive state before the observation; diagnostics require the numbered rule or syntax rule named by the facet and a conforming control differing only in the constrained feature. Notes and examples are not normative.
requirements.dependencies: Dependencies retained: generic interface syntax and interface bodies in 15.4.3.2, GENERIC statements in 15.4.3.3, expression and assignment semantics in 10.1 and 10.2, defined input/output in 12.6.4.8, procedure characteristics in 15.3 and 15.5, scope and accessibility in clause 19, processor conformance diagnostics in 4.2, and intrinsic procedures in clause 16 where an intrinsic generic name is shadowed.

accounting.rationale: Prose restriction for defined-I/O generic interface blocks.

review_rationale: Source registration for 15.4.3.4-15.4.3.4.5 and 15.4.3.5: generic identifiers, defined operations and assignments, DTIO interfaces, restrictions on generic declarations, and the EXTERNAL statement (batch222). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; C1511-C1513 carry diagnostic plans, C1514 is deferred to its existing tests, and EXTERNAL name resolution is observed through an exact ABS sentinel. Source accounting only.
